title: cura run records no check-in outcome, so nothing can ever be noticed to escalate
method: AST sweep for production call sites + read of _run_scheduled

must_not_contain: has no call site in cura/
imports CuraResponder and never constructs it

observed_at_discovery: FS-15f837197b69 covers the output half (the responder promises help with no callback). This is the input half. record_checkin(), assess_crisis_level() and CaregiverSummaryBuilder have ZERO call sites anywhere in cura/ (AST sweep, 2026-09-01); CaregiverSummaryBuilder is reachable only from cura_mcp_server.py. So missed_checkins_this_week never leaves 0, medication_adherence_rate() is vacuous, and needs_elevated_monitoring() can never become true. _run_scheduled also imports CuraResponder (cura/__main__.py:222) and never constructs it. cura run is two cron jobs that dial and print; there is no observation, no state, and no caregiver-facing output of any kind. pytest exit 1, 3 failed.
